title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Protection Deductible per Incident
content:
**When it is owed.** On an agreement with damage protection whose return inspection found accidental damage with a repair cost above zero, the renter owes the damage deductible for the incident, billed once per agreement as one deductible line.

**Amount.** The damage deductible is the class deductible for damage protection, never more than the repair cost assessed at the return inspection, and it is rounded to the nearest cent once at the end. The class deductible is the deductible per incident on the Ridgeline Tool Rental damage protection schedule.

**No deductible.** Agreements without damage protection, and inspections that found no accidental damage, carry no damage deductible.

## Decision table

| Damage protection taken | Cause recorded at the return inspection | Repair cost assessed | Deductible |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | accidental | above 0.00 | the class deductible, never more than the repair cost |
| yes | accidental | 0.00 | none |
| yes | misuse, theft or loss, tire or track damage, or no damage | any | none |
| no | any | any | none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical agreements with damage protection and accidental damage)

| Class deductible per incident | Repair cost assessed | Deductible |
|---|---|---|
| 500.00 | 3200.00 | 500.00 |
| 500.00 | 380.00 | 380.00 (held to the repair cost) |
| 250.00 | 1900.00 | 250.00 |

The repair cost is the one recorded on the return inspection line of the agreement, assessed at the class shop labor rate plus parts.
